description: This file defines the LessonList React functional component, which manages displaying a list of lessons, creating new lessons, updating existing ones, and deleting lessons. It interacts with an API abstraction for server communication and uses context for user role management.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches lessons from the API based on the current role and updates the lessons state.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new lesson with the current title and description, then reloads the lessons list.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a lesson identified by id with the provided payload, then reloads the lessons list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a lesson by id and then reloads the lessons list.
